selected_script.angle: Soggy Wet Countertop Chaos to Elegant Under-Cabinet Storage Upgrade
selected_script.hook: Stop letting your paper towel rolls sit on wet, crowded countertops.

usage_steps_used: Mount base plate onto cabinet underside or wall surface using adhesive backing or included screws
Slide a paper towel roll or plastic wrap roll onto the open end of the long holding bar

video_001_part_01.breakdown: 0-3s: Close-up POV of a hand reaching for a paper towel roll sitting directly on a wet kitchen countertop, only to lift it and show the bottom soggy, dripping, and ruined. 3-6s: The camera pans up under the cabinet where the rectangular flat mounting base plate of the brushed gold holder is mounted. A hand slides a fresh paper towel roll onto the 11.81in stainless steel holding rod. 6-10s: A close-up shows the paper towel roll hanging securely, looking clean and organized under the cabinet.

video_001_part_02.breakdown: 0-4s: Fast-cut transition to the bathroom, showing the same brushed gold L-shaped holder mounted vertically on the wall, holding a neatly folded hand towel. 4-8s: Fast-cut back to the kitchen, showing the holder under-cabinet holding a plastic wrap roll, demonstrating multi-purpose versatility. 8-10s: A final clean shot of the holder mounted under the cabinet. Text overlay appears: 'Elevate your space today.'
